ownership.quote: We, MacinCloud.com, a Moboware Inc. company (hereafter referred to as "MacinCloud"), are committed to protecting any data that we collect concerning you.

stage.note: No accelerator, VC, or press coverage of MacinCloud/Moboware Inc. funding was found; the site's own copyright notice dates the company to at least 2011 and it shows no signs of institutional funding (no investor pages, no press releases, no Crunchbase/Tracxn profile). Most likely bootstrapped, but not confirmed, so left as unknown rather than asserted.

note: MacinCloud is the product of a small, longstanding private company, Moboware Inc. (per MacinCloud's own privacy policy, copyright notices on-site run 2011-2017). No evidence of any accelerator, VC funding round, acquisition, or public revenue disclosure was found in ~15 minutes of research; most common search engines (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Mojeek, Ecosia, Startpage, searx.be) served bot-challenge/consent pages rather than results in this environment, and Crunchbase/Tracxn have no accessible profile for the company, so absence of evidence here is a weaker signal than usual. Treat funding/revenue as genuinely unknown rather than confirmed-bootstrapped.
